decision_reason: The assigned legacy Forge URL now redirects to a generic not-found page, but the exact GQE-BiOSS MetaQTL project is available on INRAE's successor Forge. It has a direct GPL-2.0-or-later source grant, a versioned 1.0.1 JAR/manual release, and documented scientific use. The latest product code/release is from March 2024, and the official URGI project record says the original project closed; current product-specific support or use after the quiet period is not established.

government_provenance.note: The exact product's source header states 'MetaQTL: a Java package for QTL Meta-Analysis' and credits INRA, France; the public project is in the GQE-BiOSS namespace on INRAE's official Forge. The INRAE URGI project page also identifies the MetaQTL tools and their institute project context: https://urgi.versailles.inrae.fr/Projects/Achieved-projects/MetaQTL.

public_source.note: The former forgemia.inra.fr URL no longer serves the repository, but the exact group/path and package description are present on the public INRAE Forge successor, with source, COPYING, tags, and a release.

eligible_license.note: The public 1.0 source tree contains the full GNU GPL version 2 text; the source HEADER explicitly offers GPL version 2 or, at the user's option, any later version. This scope statement is for MetaQTL-authored source, not third-party JAR dependencies.

primary_evidence.note: The 1.0.1 release (2024-03-27) includes an executable JAR and reference manual, and the exact package has a 2007 peer-reviewed paper. Yet the latest source commit/release is now over 24 months old, and the official URGI page describes the original project as closed; no current product-specific use/support signal was found.

product_identity: MetaQTL, a Java package/library and programs for meta-analysis and integration of QTL mapping experiments
family_note: This is the Java MetaQTL package described by its source header and research paper; distinguish it from the separately maintained BioMercator/GnpIS systems that consume or integrate MetaQTL outputs.
status_note: The dated Bioinformatics.org project page (last modified 2006-10-25) names MetaQTL and exposes Download and License links; the present download route returns 404. The surviving INRAE Forge tree contains functional source, GPL-2.0-or-later headers, and a 2023 public 1.0 tag; 1.0.1 was released in March 2024 with JAR and manual. I use 2006 only as the earliest direct product-page indication of a public download, not from imported Git commit timestamps. The old URGI project record marks the original project closed; current support/use remains a hold.

decision_reason: SHiNeMaS is an INRAE-developed, reusable web database for seed-lot history and associated phenotype, environmental, and cultivation data. It has public source on the current INRAE Forge, an AGPL-3.0 grant, current v2.2 source maintenance, installation/user documentation, peer-reviewed production use, and current LiveSeeding development evidence.

government_provenance.note: The exact SHiNeMaS article describes the software as developed through an INRA/INRAE collaboration with the farmer network and lists INRAE/Université Paris-Saclay/CNRS affiliations. The official GQE/UGEBIO page says other research teams and farmer organizations tested and now use it: https://comite-agriculture-biologique.hub.inrae.fr/les-outils-de-recherche/les-programmes-inra-dedies-a-l-ab/inra-agribio/agribio-42/ugebio.

public_source.note: The exact public INRAE Forge successor contains the current SHiNeMaS source, tags through v2.2, and release history. The formerly assigned forgemia.inra.fr path redirects to a generic error; the same group, project name, description, and repository history are present on this successor.

eligible_license.note: The direct COPYING file at the current v2.2 source tag is the full GNU Affero General Public License version 3. This pass covers SHiNeMaS-authored application code; third-party dependencies and user-provided seed/breeding data retain their own terms.

primary_evidence.note: The 2025 LiveSeeding Data Management Plan documents an updated SHiNeMaS version and identifies INRAE's source repository, providing current product-specific development evidence. The installation manual covers source download, dependencies, database setup, deployment, and use: https://shinemas2.readthedocs.io/en/latest/installation/installation.html. The 2020 paper reports five years of laboratory production use and farmers' organizations managing their own data.

product_identity: SHiNeMaS (Seeds History and Network Management System), a web application/database to manage seed-lot histories, phenotyping, environmental data, and cultural practices
agency: INRAE, GQE-Le Moulon/GQE-BiOSS, developed with the Réseau Semences Paysannes and research/farmer partners
family_note: The software manages partner/farmer data but does not relicense that user-provided content. Third-party libraries and data remain under their own terms; this decision concerns the application code and its documented functions.
status_note: The current INRAE Forge record dates the public project to 2019-07-17; a 2019 v1.1 user guide and the 2020 peer-reviewed paper corroborate public distribution, and the latter states the source is under AGPL and that it had been used in production for five years. Current tag v2.2 is dated 2026-07-16; a 2025 LiveSeeding plan documents continued software updates. The old forgemia.inra.fr host now redirects to an error page; the exact repo is available at the successor forge.inrae.fr address.
